lead: Saina Nehwal is a widely followed Indian badminton player, born on 17 March 1990 in Dhindar.
As of 2026, she is 36 years old, and her birth date places her under the Pisces sign.
She has been recognised with CNN-News18 Indian of the Year and Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in Sports and Games.
This profile collects the Saina facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Saina Nehwal — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Saina Nehwal was born on 17 March 1990 in Dhindar, and holds Indian nationality.
She received her education at Campus School, CCS HAU and National Institute of Rural Development.
She is recorded as speaking English and Hindi.

sections.heading: Saina Nehwal — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists badminton player and Olympic competitor as her occupations.

She has taken part in badminton at the 2014 Asian Games – women's singles, badminton at the 2006 Asian Games – women's singles, badminton at the 2010 Asian Games – women's team, badminton at the 2012 Summer Olympics – women's singles and badminton at the 2006 Commonwealth Games – women's singles.
